About KCVA

A student-driven interscholastic league built on competition, integrity, and varsity pride.

What is KCVA

KC Varsity Association (KCVA) is a premier, student-driven interscholastic sports league dedicated to elevating high school athletics. Founded on the principles of fierce competition, integrity, and varsity pride, KCVA organizes professional-grade tournaments across Volleyball, Ultimate Frisbee, and emerging varsity disciplines for high schools and international programs.

Beyond the scoreboard, KCVA serves as an empowering platform for young student-athletes, organizers, and campus communities. By combining tournament standards, high-energy live atmospheres, and creative collaboration, we cultivate leadership, teamwork, and an enduring passion for sports that extends far beyond the court.
